Description: Canoga Park is a neighborhood in the western San Fernando Valley of Los Angeles, bordered by Chatsworth to the north, Winnetka to the east, Woodland Hills to the south and West Hills to the west. Founded as Owensmouth in 1912, it was annexed to the City of Los Angeles in 1917 and renamed Canoga Park in 1931. It is a dense, largely flat inland-valley neighborhood built around the Sherman Way commercial corridor, adjacent to the Warner Center office district and to long-established aerospace-propulsion manufacturing on De Soto Avenue.
